My soul... it has been trapped here. You're the only ones I can trust now.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
我的灵魂...被困在这里了。现在你们是我唯一能信任的人。

scripts.text: Nidhoggur's Shadow?
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子？

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Guardian Nidhoggur... he's not in the nest.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
守护者尼德霍格...他不在巢穴里。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
He...for some reason abandoned his own shadow, and left.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
他...不知为何抛弃了自己的影子，离开了。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
All that's left, is the ugly Shadow of the Guardian of Nidhoggur...the Shadow that is going mad.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
剩下的，只有尼德霍格那丑陋的影子...那个已经发疯的影子。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Shadow sucked all the nutrients from the World Tree Yggdrasil, and has gone mad when there is nothing more left to obtain. Now, he wants this land.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
影子吸干了世界树尤克特拉希尔的所有养分，在无可获取时便陷入了疯狂。现在，它想要这片土地。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Once the ugly Shadow leaves here to steal power from the other World Yggdrasil Trees, there will be great destruction. This world will become hell.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
一旦这丑陋的影子离开这里，去其他世界树那里夺取力量，就会带来巨大的毁灭。这个世界将变成地狱。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
You must... tell the commanders of Alfheim about this, and come up with a plan. Only them...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
你们必须...告诉艾尔弗雷姆的指挥官们这件事，并制定计划。只有他们...

scripts.text: Is there nothing else we can do?
scripts.translation: 我们还能做别的吗？

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
With our current powers...it is impossible to defeat the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
以我们目前的力量...不可能击败守护者。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
But the one going mad is not the Guardian, but his dark Shadow...maybe we can trap him here...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
但发疯的不是守护者，而是他的黑暗影子...也许我们可以将他困在这里...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Are you willing to accept this mission? Even if it means to pay with your life?
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
你们愿意接受这个任务吗？即使这意味着要用生命作为代价？

scripts.text: Leave it to us.
scripts.translation: 交给我们吧。

scripts.text: We can't do it.
scripts.translation: 我们做不到。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
I thank you deeply for your decision. I will use what is left of my powers to open up the path towards the Guardian's Nest.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
我深深感谢你们的决定。我将用我剩余的力量，打开通往守护者巢穴的道路。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms of the Sanctuary will start immediately.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
通往守护者巢穴的道路就在北方那棵巨大的世界树尤克特拉希尔旁的水瀑之后。光耀之堂的防御机制将立即启动。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North. The defensive mechanisms will start immediately.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
通往守护者巢穴的道路就在北方那棵巨大的世界树尤克特拉希尔旁的水瀑之后。防御机制将立即启动。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Defeat all of Nidhoggur's guardians and go through the waterfall into the nest... and stop Nidhoggur's Shadow there.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
击败尼德霍格的所有守卫，穿过水瀑进入巢穴...在那里阻止尼德霍格的影子。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The gate will open soon. Go defeat all of the guardians... you must kill them all in 30 minutes before the gate opens...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
大门很快就会打开。去击败所有守卫...你们必须在30分钟内全部击杀，大门才会打开...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
30 minutes... that's the limit of my powers. Please hurry.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
30分钟...这是我力量的极限。请快一点。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
And... Be careful... Be careful of the shadow's power.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
还有...小心...小心影子的力量。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The gate will open soon. Go defeat all of the guardians.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
大门很快就会打开。去击败所有守卫吧。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The path to the Guardian's Nest is just past the waterfall by the large World Tree Yggdrasil to the North.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
通往守护者巢穴的道路就在北方那棵巨大的世界树尤克特拉希尔旁的水瀑之后。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Use your powers... and destroy the vile Shadow...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
使用你们的力量...摧毁那邪恶的影子...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
This is... all I can do for you...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
这...是我能为你们做的全部了...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Those who want to taint the sacred Sanctuary of the Guardian... Get out.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
想要玷污守护者神圣的<光耀之堂>...滚出去。

scripts.text: What's a woman from the Laphine Tribe doing here...
scripts.translation: 拉芬族的女子怎么会在这里...

scripts.text: What's happening? Let's go check it out.
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？我们去看看。

scripts.text: From below the gorgeous stones, a strange breeze is forming.
scripts.translation: 华丽的石块下方，正形成一阵奇异的微风。

scripts.text: The strange power slowly surrounds your body, the dimension is starting to shift.
scripts.translation: 那股奇异的力量缓缓包裹住你的身体，空间开始扭曲。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Thank you. You're the saviour of humans and the Laphine Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
谢谢。你们是拯救人类和拉芬族的救世主。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
You've defeated Nidhoggur's Shadow. But...It's not gone for good. Its powers are merely put to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
你们击败了尼德霍格的影子。但是...它并没有彻底消失。它只是陷入了沉睡。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
But you have won us plenty of time. This is great.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
不过，你们为我们争取到了宝贵的时间。这很好。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Please go and report this to those in charge of Splendide and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
请去告知辉煌领域和马努克的负责人。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
As you have seen, neither the Sapha tribe nor the Laphine tribe is at fault for the weakening of the World Tree. It's all because of the Guardian's Shadow...
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
正如你们所见，萨法族和拉芬族都不是世界树衰弱的原因。一切都是因为守护者的影子...

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
The Guardian's insanity...is caused by powers unknown to us... You must tell this to everyone.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
守护者的疯狂...是由我们未知的力量引起的...你们必须告诉所有人。

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Now... Allow me to escort you out of the cursed nest.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
现在...请允许我护送你们离开这个被诅咒的巢穴。

scripts.text: Please let me out.
scripts.translation: 请让我出去

scripts.text: I want to look around for a while.
scripts.translation: 我想再四处看看

scripts.text:
[World Tree Yggdrasil]
Is that so... I'll be around if you want to leave.
scripts.translation:
[世界树 尤克特拉希尔]
是吗...如果你想离开，我就在这里。
